main_body: prehistoric cycad / palm-like tree with crown and straight trunk
top_band: light green central crown/bud and upper frond surface across rows 1-10
evidence: The tree shows a visible top crown surface (central light green cone/bud at rows 1-7 and upper radiating fronds down to ~row 10) overhanging the lower hanging fronds and shaded vertical trunk (rows 11-54), with dark eave shadow where the trunk meets the underside of the canopy (rows 18-21).

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, organically branching Beodeul reference trees with 6+ green/brown shading steps and colored outlines, the candidate has a completely rigid, ruler-straight 6px-wide column trunk with a repetitive 4-row tile pattern, heavy near-black outlines around the central bud and fronds, and much lower structural and shading complexity.
